description: This is a Java unit test class for the class QueryParametersToHeadersMap, testing its immutability, null handling, and conversion logic for query parameters to headers based on HTTP config.

classes.name: QueryParametersToHeadersMapTest
classes.description: Unit test class for QueryParametersToHeadersMap, using MockitoJUnitRunner to test conversions and error handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that QueryParametersToHeadersMap is immutable, assuming certain fields are safely copied and unmodifiable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullHttpConfig
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to getInstance throws a NullPointerException with correct message.

methods.name: tryToConvertNullQueryParameters
methods.description: Tests that applying null query parameters results in a NullPointerException.

methods.name: convertEmptyQueryParameters
methods.description: Confirms that empty query parameters produce an empty map.

methods.name: convertQueryParametersWithoutConfiguredHeaderNames
methods.description: Checks that query parameters with no matching header config produce an empty result.

methods.name: convertQueryParameters
methods.description: Tests standard conversion of query params to headers based on HTTP config and expectations.
